question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}2.3\overset{―}{43} & =2.343\,43... \\  & =2.3+0.043+0.000\,43+0.000\,004\,3+… \\  & =2.3+{{\frac{43}{1\,000}+\frac{43}{100\,000}+\frac{43}{10\,000\,000}+⋯.}_{⏟}}_{\text{geometric series}}\end{aligned}
$$

We see that we have a geometric series where the first term is ${a}_{1}=\frac{43}{1\,000}$ and the common ratio is $\frac{1}{100}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}2.3\overset{―}{43} & =2.3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =2.3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{43}{1\,000}{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n-1} \\  & =2.3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{43\cdot 100}{1\,000}{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n} \\  & =2.3+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{43}{10}{(\frac{1}{100})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
